Question Choices: Evaluate lim x->0 of sin(6x)/x. Use radians.
Solution: In radians, sin(u)/u tends to 1 as u->0. For nonzero constants a,b, rewrite sin(ax)/(bx)=(a/b)[sin(ax)/(ax)], so its limit is a/b. Degree-valued inputs introduce the conversion factor pi/180; they do not give the same standard limit 1. lim x->0 of sin(6*x)/x = 6
